newsitem.title: UK: Avon sells tyre unit for 60 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Avon sells tyre unit for 60 mln stg.

text.p: Avon Rubber Plc said on Tuesday it has agreed to to sell its tyres division to a subsidiary of U.S. firm Cooper Tire & Rubber Company for 60 million stg cash.
The company said in a statement that the disposal will enable it to concentrate its resources on its automotive components and technical products divisions.
The sale will result in an exceptional profit of around 12 million stg before tax.

This, together with a provision of four million for the costs of relocating its technical products division and the costs of the tyres sale, will be reflected in its results for the year ended September 27, 1997.
Avon Rubber said that overall performance of its automotive components and technical products divisions has remained in line with expectations.
"Overall the Avon Group's prospects for the current financial year remain encouraging," said the firm.
